knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Low oxygen from a stopped pump is the most likely immediate cause, so pump and aeration come first.
Gradual cleaning keeps the bacteria and plants that stabilise the pond. A full clean removes them and can cause a sudden collapse of water quality.
Only products approved for the pond system, used under the owner's instruction and the product label, are appropriate.

practicalCriteria: Learner checks pump and aeration on a simulated pond before reviewing the water test results
Learner declines a planted request for pool chlorine and records the reason
Learner performs a simulated gradual debris removal and records what was left in place
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Visit record with temperature and pump status
Referral or refusal record for a requested product
Assessor observation of the first-response steps in a simulation
stopWorkCriteria: Request to add pool chemicals or a non-approved product to the pond
Multiple fish deaths or a suspected disease
Unusual odour or cloudiness that does not respond to the usual steps
